title: Warehouses
description: Manage the locations that hold your stock.

help.title: About Warehouses
help.overview: A warehouse is a place that holds stock. Inventory is stored per product or variant in a warehouse: on hand, and reserved for open checkouts. Name and code are required.

sections.title: Where checkout takes stock
sections.body: A line is reserved only when an inventory row exists for that product or variant. A line with no row is treated as untracked.
items: The default active warehouse is used when it has enough available stock. Otherwise the first warehouse that can cover the quantity is used.
Only one warehouse is the default. Set default clears the previous default.
Deactivate stops the warehouse from being chosen. If it is the only warehouse on a till, deactivation is blocked until that till has another warehouse.
Deleting a warehouse is a soft delete and it can be restored.
